title: Inpainting
source: txt2img/result.webp, downscaled to 512x512; the mask is a rectangle from 75,0 to 260,190 in that frame, the clear sky between the rigging pole and the figure
notes: source_processing must be "inpainting", the model must be an inpainting model, and the mask must match the source dimensions. White is the region that gets repainted. The mask is sent as the lossless PNG beside the result so its binary edge is not softened in transit. Pinned to world 1 because every inpainting model the Horde serves is SD1.5: the anime and non-human worlds have no inpainting checkpoint to run this on. The model is the base SD1.5 inpainting checkpoint the locked palette names, not a merge of it.
